description:
Second phase of bl-7c23. Replace the embedded conversation-repo template with the new shape.

=== Scope ===

1. Rewrite template/ source dir:
   - Remove .agent/ subtree entirely.
   - Add top-level files: manifest.yaml (role-keyed shape per ARCH §5.2), workflow.yaml (event bindings, with spawn_root_conversation), providers.yaml (roles: only — no providers/models), version.
   - Add souls/ dir with worker.md and compactor.md (existing prompts, relocated).
   - Add an empty root/ subdir convention placeholder (or have src/template/ create root/ at scaffold time with .git initialized inside).
   - .gitattributes: pin goal.md, soul.md, summary/** to merge=ours. Committed as part of the initial scaffold commit on main, inside root/.
2. Update src/template/mod.rs: scaffold creates <conv-repo>/ at <harness-root>/conversations/<root-id>/ (or path arg if explicit), copies template tree, runs git init inside root/, commits initial state.
3. lernie new accepts an optional name; default to a generated id; emits the conv-repo path on stdout.
4. src/template/tests.rs: assert the scaffolded shape end-to-end matches ARCH §2.2.

=== Constraints ===

- This phase BREAKS the existing prompt path (which still expects .agent/ paths). Do not merge to main alone — pair with Phase 3, OR ensure the prompt path is feature-flagged behind an old-vs-new template detector. Cleanest: pair with Phase 3 in one ball at review time.
- A practical option: this phase lands the new template scaffold but keeps the prompt path on the v0.2 .agent/ layout via a 'compat' shim that reads from .agent/ if present, root/ otherwise; Phase 3 removes the shim. Up to the claimer.

=== Out of scope ===

- Branch/step path changes (Phase 3).
- Compactor path migration (Phase 5).

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: Phase 2: template skeleton + scaffolding
